verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's own GitHub integration lets you mention @gemini-cli in issues and PRs for 'task delegation', which is a form of remotely run agent work. Nothing in the evidence shows that delegated agent building, testing, and demoing a feature end-to-end for review. Community reports of agentic loops and failed edits lower confidence but do not concretely address the cloud delegation flow. missing for 10: documented cloud/remote agent execution environment, autonomous build-and-test runs, demo artifacts (screenshots/video/preview) for review, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end delegated feature delivery.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
Run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
